description: Experience the viral sensation of Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread, a delightful fusion of sweet, savory, and utterly irresistible flavors. This popular street food features soft bread generously filled with a creamy, tangy cream cheese mixture and coated in a rich, buttery garlic sauce. Perfect as a snack or appetizer, it is sure to impress with its unique taste and comforting texture.

ingredients.item: Brioche buns or milk bread rolls

instructions.title: Prepare the Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, 3 tablespoons of granulated sugar, and 2 tablespoons of heavy cream. Mix well with a whisk or spatula until the mixture is smooth and creamy. Transfer the filling into a piping bag fitted with a round tip, or use a spoon if a piping bag is unavailable. Set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Garlic Butter Glaze
instructions.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted unsalted butter, minced garlic, 2 tablespoons of granulated sugar, the beaten egg, and 2 tablespoons of milk or heavy cream. Mix until all ingredients are well combined. The glaze should have a slightly thick, emulsified consistency. Stir in the dried parsley flakes.

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 160°C (325°F). Take each brioche bun or milk bread roll and make 6 deep cuts into it, starting from the top and going about three-quarters of the way down, creating a floral or star shape. Be careful not to cut all the way through the bottom.

instructions.title: Fill the Bread
instructions.text: Carefully open up the cuts in each bread roll. Pipe or spoon the cream cheese filling generously into each crevice. Ensure the filling is evenly distributed within the bread, making sure each section gets a good amount of the creamy deliciousness.

instructions.title: Glaze and Bake
instructions.text: Dip each filled bread roll into the garlic butter glaze, making sure to coat all sides and seep into the cuts. You can also spoon the glaze over the bread. Place the glazed bread rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and fragrant.

instructions.title: Serve Warm
instructions.text: Once baked, remove the Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread from the oven. Let it cool for a few minutes before serving. The bread is best enjoyed warm, when the cream cheese filling is soft and gooey, and the garlic butter glaze is rich and aromatic. Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh parsley if desired.

tips: To achieve a perfect consistency for the cream cheese filling, ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature before mixing. This prevents lumps and ensures a smooth, pipeable texture.
For an extra aromatic garlic flavor, gently toast the minced garlic in a small amount of butter before adding it to the main glaze mixture. This mellows the raw garlic bite.
If you dont have a piping bag, you can use a small spoon to carefully insert the cream cheese filling into the bread crevices. Ensure the cuts are deep enough to accommodate the filling.
article:
Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread has taken the culinary world by storm, captivating foodies with its unique blend of sweet, savory, and utterly creamy deliciousness. Originating from the bustling bakeries and vibrant street food scene of South Korea, this isn't your average garlic bread. It’s a gourmet experience, transforming a simple loaf into an irresistible treat that's perfect for any time of day. If you've ever wondered how to recreate this viral sensation in your own kitchen, you're in the right place. Get ready to embark on a delightful Korean baking adventure that promises rich flavors and satisfying textures.

## What is Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread?
At its heart, Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a brilliant fusion of textures and tastes. Imagine a pillowy soft, often brioche-like or milk bread, deeply cut into six wedges but still connected at the base. These cuts are then generously filled with a slightly sweet, tangy cream cheese mixture. But the magic doesn't stop there. The entire loaf is then drenched in a rich, aromatic garlic butter sauce that often includes a touch of sugar, milk, and sometimes even mayonnaise or egg yolk for an unbelievably glossy finish and extra richness.

Unlike traditional Italian-American garlic bread, which is purely savory and often crispy, the Korean version offers a delightful contrast. The bread itself is typically softer, absorbing the luscious garlic butter glaze while maintaining its tender interior. The sweet cream cheese filling provides a refreshing counterpoint to the pungent garlic and savory butter, creating a harmonious flavor profile that is both addictive and incredibly satisfying. It’s a testament to Korean baking innovation, turning a familiar concept into something entirely new and exciting.

## Ingredients You'll Need

To make authentic Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread, you'll need a few key components. The quality of your ingredients will significantly impact the final taste and texture.

For the Bread:
*   1 round loaf of soft bread (e.g., milk bread, brioche, or a good quality French boulot/boule. Avoid overly crusty bread.)

For the Cream Cheese Filling:
*   8 oz (226g) cream cheese, softened
*   1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar
*   2 tablespoons heavy cream or milk
*   1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract (optional, for extra aroma)

For the Garlic Butter Glaze:
*   1/2 cup (113g) unsalted butter, melted
*   6-8 cloves garlic, minced very finely
*   1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar
*   2 tablespoons milk
*   1 tablespoon mayonnaise (optional, but highly recommended for richness and shine)
*   1 large egg yolk (optional, for richness and golden color)
*   2 tablespoons fresh parsley, finely chopped

## Step-by-Step Instructions

Creating this masterpiece of Korean baking is simpler than you might think. Follow these steps for perfect Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread every time.

1.  **Prepare the Bread:** Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Take your round loaf of bread and slice it into six equal wedges, cutting almost all the way through to the base but leaving the bottom intact. This creates pockets for the filling and allows the glaze to seep in.
2.  **Make the Cream Cheese Filling:** In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, sugar, heavy cream (or milk), and vanilla extract (if using). Beat with an electric mixer or whisk until smooth, creamy, and lump-free. Transfer this mixture into a piping bag fitted with a wide round tip, or simply use a spoon.
3.  **Prepare the Garlic Butter Glaze:** In another bowl, combine the melted butter, minced garlic, sugar, milk, mayonnaise (if using), and egg yolk (if using). Whisk vigorously until all ingredients are well combined and the mixture looks slightly emulsified. Stir in the fresh chopped parsley.
4.  **Fill the Bread:** Carefully open the cuts in your bread and generously pipe or spoon the cream cheese filling into each crevice. You want each wedge to have a good amount of filling.
5.  **Glaze the Bread:** Gently dip the entire filled loaf into the garlic butter glaze, ensuring all the cut sides and the top are thoroughly coated. Alternatively, you can place the bread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and generously spoon or brush the glaze over every part of the bread, letting it seep into the cuts.
6.  **Bake:** Place the glazed bread on the parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown, the cream cheese is slightly bubbly, and the garlic butter is fragrant and caramelized. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning.
7.  **Serve:** Let it cool for a few minutes before serving warm.

## Pro Tips for the Best Results

Achieving that perfect balance of flavors and textures in your Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread requires a few insider tricks:

*   **Choose Your Bread Wisely:** A soft, slightly sweet bread like milk bread or brioche works best as it absorbs the glaze beautifully without becoming soggy. If using a baguette, ensure it's a softer variety.
*   **Soften Cream Cheese Thoroughly:** This is crucial for a smooth, lump-free filling. Take it out of the fridge at least an hour before use, or gently microwave for 15-20 seconds.
*   **Don't Skimp on Garlic:** Freshly minced garlic is key. Avoid garlic powder for the glaze, as it won't give the same aromatic depth.
*   **Emulsify the Glaze:** Whisk the garlic butter glaze vigorously until it's well combined. The mayonnaise and egg yolk (if used) help create a stable emulsion, leading to a richer, glossier finish.
*   **Generous Application:** Don't be shy with the cream cheese filling or the garlic butter glaze. The generous quantities are what make Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread so decadent.
*   **Cut Carefully:** When slicing the bread, ensure you don't cut all the way through the base. This keeps the loaf together while allowing for deep filling and glazing.

## Serving Suggestions

Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is incredibly versatile. While it's often enjoyed as a standalone snack or dessert in Korea, it can also be a fantastic accompaniment to various meals.

*   **Breakfast/Brunch:** Serve it warm with a cup of coffee or tea for a delightful start to your day. The sweet and savory notes pair wonderfully with a hot beverage.
*   **Snack:** It makes an excellent afternoon treat to curb those sweet and savory cravings.
*   **Appetizer:** Cut the baked loaf into individual wedges and serve them as a unique appetizer at your next gathering. It’s sure to be a conversation starter.
*   **Side Dish:** While unconventional, it can complement certain savory dishes, particularly those with a lighter flavor profile, where its richness won't overpower the main course.

## Variations & Substitutions

Once you've mastered the classic Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread, feel free to experiment with these delicious variations:

*   **Spicy Kick:** Add a pinch of Korean chili flakes (gochugaru) to the garlic butter glaze for a subtle heat that complements the sweetness.
*   **Herb Power:** Experiment with different fresh herbs. Chives or green onions can be used in place of, or in addition to, parsley for a slightly different aromatic profile.
*   **Cheesy Twist:** For an extra layer of savory flavor, sprinkle some shredded mozzarella or Parmesan cheese over the top of the bread before baking.
*   **Vegan Option:** Use plant-based cream cheese, vegan butter, and substitute milk with a plant-based alternative. Omit the egg yolk and mayonnaise, or use vegan substitutes. The texture might vary slightly, but it will still be delicious.
*   **Different Breads:** While round loaves are traditional, you can adapt this recipe for sliced sandwich bread or even a ciabatta loaf, though the presentation will differ.
*   **Sweetness Adjustment:** Adjust the amount of sugar in both the cream cheese filling and the garlic butter glaze to suit your preference. Some prefer it sweeter, others less so.

Making Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread at home is a rewarding experience that brings the vibrant flavors of Korean baking right into your kitchen. With its irresistible combination of soft bread, sweet cream cheese, and savory garlic butter, it's a dish that's sure to impress and delight anyone who tries it. So, gather your ingredients, follow these steps, and prepare to indulge in a truly spectacular treat!
